purpose: Three owner-requested visual proposals; no selected style or implementation approval

variants.name: 1 — Живое царство
variants.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, high-fidelity visual CONCEPT for the Russian village-building RPG "Дезертовия". This is an actual designed game UI screen, not a photo of a device and not a generic website. Portrait composition, approximately 4:5, readable Cyrillic text. The same functional content must be used for all variants: header "ДЕЗЕРТОВИЯ", screen title "ОБЩАЯ ФЕРМА", compact top indicators with small pictorial icons and numbers: 320 coins, 84 food, energy 28/36. Three clearly separate bed cards: "Грядка 1" with ripe turnips and small label "Готово"; "Грядка 2" with carrots at 30% growth and label "Нужен полив"; "Грядка 3" with empty soil and label "Пусто". The second bed is visibly selected. Below it show compact action area with a large tactile primary button labelled "ПОЛИТЬ", a tiny water/energy cost indicator, and a small round information button "i". Bottom navigation has four pictorial tabs with short labels "Карта", "Герой", "Царство", "Сумка". Small close button in the farm window. Most communication is visual: illustrated crops, water, soil, clear state symbols and progress bars. No paragraphs, no repeated explanatory text, no premium offers, no payment UI, no tiny low-contrast text. Strong hierarchy, generous touch targets, modest decorative framing that never overwhelms the content. Crisp attractive game illustrations and a cohesive icon set; production-quality art direction. This is a style proposal, not a claim of implemented code. STYLE VARIANT 1: "Живое царство". Warm, vivid, tactile hand-painted village game art. Carved honey-colored wood, a few aged iron fasteners, soft linen panels, terracotta soil beds and healthy lush green crops. Restrained sunny amber highlights, warm cream lettering surfaces, turquoise water icons. Illustrations feel like real objects from a cozy but grounded medieval village. Richer and more crafted than a flat form, yet clean, contemporary and readable on a phone. Use a subtle village landscape near the header, not behind text. Card corners slightly rounded with believable wood/cloth framing. The primary water button is confident blue-teal; selected card has a warm golden outline. No manuscript/parchment book treatment, no dark fantasy treatment. Add a neat small concept label at the very top: "1 · ЖИВОЕ ЦАРСТВО".
